selected_evidence.requirement: Record sudo commands with user and timestamp in /var/log/sudo-commands.log
selected_evidence.summary: Sudoers validation succeeded, and live pre- and post-restart commands generated timestamped records containing the invoking user, target user, and full command. The logfile is root-owned and mode 0600.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep sudo command entries out of the general system log
selected_evidence.summary: Unique sudo command markers were found in the dedicated file and absent from messages, secure, and the general journal both before and after restart.
The existing logrotate timer was healthy; the new dedicated rule passed complete configuration validation before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state/data
